identitySignals: The agenda name pairs "City of Oakland" with "A Nonprofit Public Benefit Corporation". The City of Oakland is a municipal government, not a nonprofit corporation, so the name is internally inconsistent.

The contract is a subcontract under a state General Child Development Program (CCTR-0010) grant for an early childhood department. That fits the City of Oakland's Human Services Department, which runs Head Start and early childhood programs. It would also fit a separate nonprofit, so it doesn't settle which entity this is.
The agenda gives no city or state, and I found no registry record (California Secretary of State, IRS or ProPublica) for a nonprofit with this exact name.
research.notes: I couldn't tell whether this vendor is the City of Oakland itself (a public agency, probably its Human Services Department) or a separate nonprofit public benefit corporation tied to the City. The agenda wording may be garbled. Because a wrong website, phone number or registry ID would be a serious error, I left every profile field empty. A reviewer should check the original OUSD agenda item and contract to see which entity signed.
